title: Timing and Counting
lead: Covers lecture 07 and exercise 5: why timers/counters, how an 8-bit and a 16-bit timer work, elapsed-time and initial-value formulas, the registers TCCRnB, TCNTn, TIFRn (write-one-to-clear) and TIMSKn, systems 10 to 14 (count events, 200 ms blinker, polling and interrupts), and the reaction timer exercise with random numbers. Built from the slides and peer notes pages 39 to 40. Part 2 adds beginner explanations with diagrams, the reaction timer built step by step, and what the lecturer explained in the two 2020 timing-and-counting recordings.
